meta.title: Vision tiler
meta.description: Reads high-resolution images through the segment_image tool: one overview plus overlapping tiles, so small text survives instead of being downscaled away. Each batch returns PNG attachments and a DeepSeek vision-token estimate. The tool is offered only for the models listed in its settings, so other providers keep their own image handling. Every call adds model requests and vision tokens; disable the plugin to remove the tool.

settings.unavailable: The Host does not expose this plugin's settings. Enable the plugin and restart DSH.
settings.readOnly: This profile stores settings read-only; the plugin keeps its current configuration.
settings.intro: These options apply to the next segment_image call.
settings.saveFailed: The Host did not accept the change. Review the values and try again.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a number within the stated range.
settings.targetTilePixelsHint: Pixels per coverage tile. 768 × 768 costs 382 DeepSeek vision tokens.
settings.overlapRatioHint: 0 to 0.499 of the tile. Empty uses the per-mode default: 0.15 auto, 0.18 document, 0.2 diagram, 0.12 photo.
settings.minOverlapPixelsHint: Pixels; neighbouring tiles keep at least this much shared area.
settings.maxTotalTilesHint: The tool refuses an image that needs more coverage tiles.
settings.maxImagesPerBatchHint: Including the overview; the Host's own limit still applies.
settings.includeOverviewHint: A downscaled full-image view with every batch.
settings.defaultStrategyHint: Used when the caller does not pass strategy.
settings.detailCropCountHint: Dense-region crops. Empty restores the installed value, or the per-strategy default of 1 for adaptive and 0 for uniform.
settings.modelsHint: One prefix per line. * allows every model; an empty list hides the tool.
